summary: The current `FloorToUnit` implementation in `absl/time/time.cc` always returns the truncated quotient, matching the negative fractional conversion failures. The separate `ToUnixSeconds` failure near `int64_t` minimum needs the seconds conversion implementation and its overflow behavior before a complete repair can be identified.
hypotheses: `FloorToUnit` drops the negative-remainder adjustment, so coarse conversions truncate toward zero instead of flooring.
`ToInt64Seconds` or its underlying division path mishandles values just below the minimum representable whole-second count.
